authorization: 用户同意复用已有预测重算；仅CPU补充分析，不改变历史冻结协议，不授权训练/推理/Test或新的正式主指标。
comparison: NL minus N0, paired seed2027/2028, existing fixed100epochs endpoints
data: same Dev28 and existing native GT/FOV/Omega/hemorrhage-near masks; no new GT or patient independence claim
targets: Reuse existing frozen B2 candidate GT graph paths (open, relative FOV body width median<=6, reference length>=20). Keep only path coordinates within original near & Omega. Deduplicate within each path; retain shared anchors across paths explicitly. No new pruning, thresholds or path pairing.
primary_diagnostic: Per path near-portion d1 recall; mean paths within image; mean valid images. Zero near targets -> NA; same target set for all four predictions.
support: prediction>=0.5 & Omega; Euclidean d1<=1 native pixel (center +4 neighbours); no diagonal or new tolerance
secondary: full Omega path d1 for same near-intersecting paths
adjacent edge hit coverage inside contiguous valid near runs; not true connectivity
near FP / area and FP / background
denominators: All28 rows retained. Report per path/image counts, images and paths with1-2 target pixels, shared point occurrences vs unique positions; no removal of sparse images.

statistics.bootstrap: image paired 1000 reps; fixed seed20261016; percentile95%; exploratory, no multiplicity correction
statistics.seeds: separately and average paired delta within image before bootstrap; not independent patients
statistics.influence: leave each valid image out once, diagnostic only

interpretation: No new success/failure threshold. Do not replace past endpoint or declare a method successful. Broader candidate paths remain GT-engineering proxies, not medical truth. NL was trained under old S3 targets; these scores describe endpoints, not an experiment designed for the new target.
stop: Any GT/probability hash or reproduced original Dice/S3 inconsistency stops scoring and is reported.
outputs: Existing terminal_evaluation analysis directory; prefixed plan/script/CSV/JSON/Chinese report; existing STATUS/decisions updated after verification. PPT unchanged.
